### Who Among Us Is Crying Out for Help?
Author: Cara Meredith
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-july-19.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 23:15
Points:
- Adults frequently hesitate to voice their needs, in contrast to young children who readily ask for assistance.
- Surrounded by his warriors during wartime, David did not hide his basic longing for water from the gate of Bethlehem.
- Believers should cultivate attentiveness to both the spoken requests and quiet heartaches of those nearby.
- Paying attention enables concrete acts of care alongside intentional, persistent prayer for others.

### Day 75: 2 Samuel 23:8–17
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-75-2-samuel-23-817.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 23:8-17
Points:
- God brought deliverance to David through his warriors rather than making David the sole victor.
- Keeping leaders off unhealthy pedestals protects both the congregation and the leaders from destructive hero worship.
- Requiring help protected David from pride, self-sufficiency, and the perils of isolated leadership.
- The Lord works through anyone who surrenders to Him, refusing to limit His power to a single person.
